# Contributing to GuGram

Bug reports, documentation fixes, and focused feature pull requests are welcome.
Please open them in [nobottomline/GuGram](https://github.com/nobottomline/GuGram).

For bugs, include the GuGram commit or version, operating system, reproduction
steps, expected behavior, and actual behavior. Redact account details, API
credentials, proxy secrets, and personal message content from diagnostics.

For code changes, keep each pull request focused, preserve upstream compatibility,
and describe the checks you ran. Build in Debug using the [platform guides](../README.md#build).
Changes to export or storage behavior should also run the [video-export tests](../docs/video-downloads.md#verification).
Never commit account data, build caches, signing keys, or private API credentials.

GuGram is independently maintained. Telegram account restrictions and login
problems that also affect the official clients belong with
[Telegram support](https://telegram.org/support).
